meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后,当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的缺陷并要修复时,Claude 会先在临时目录里还原最新代码、复现问题,再写最小修复补丁并验证,最后按规则提交:属于 LazyCodex 的材料以问题和补丁形式发布,属于上游 Codex 的则发成拉取请求,并附上验证记录。
howto.when: 当你要求修复缺陷、贡献修补、为缺陷发 PR,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 问题,且问题能复现时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复一下 LazyCodex 的安装报错,并提交验证结果。
say.note: 会按规则生成带补丁的验证问题,不发 PR。

say.text: 这个 openai/codex 的 CLI bug 请排查并帮我开个 PR。
say.note: 会从临时克隆创建分支并以 fork PR 形式交付。

say.text: 调试一个 omo-codex 的 bug,把修复流程走完。
say.note: 会复现、写测试、验证后按归属仓库交付。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you report a LazyCodex or Codex defect to fix, Claude materializes latest sources in a temp dir, reproduces the bug, implements the smallest fix, verifies it, and delivers it: as an issue with embedded patch for LazyCodex-owned repos, or as a fork PR for upstream openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect that can be reproduced.

say_en.text: Help me fix the LazyCodex install error and submit the verified result.
say_en.note: Creates a verified-fix issue with patch, not a PR.

say_en.text: Investigate this openai/codex CLI bug and open a PR for me.
say_en.note: Creates a temporary clone and delivers a fork PR.

say_en.text: Debug an omo-codex bug and run the full fix workflow.
say_en.note: Reproduces, tests, verifies, then delivers by target repo.
